scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for every integer depth; exact finite checks are supporting, not an infinite-dimensional certificate. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Uniform binary product measure, homogeneous whole-level Haar masks, finite depth; no extension to arbitrary node masks or biased filtration. Incomplete historical coverage of a relevant 2012 Russian-language paper.
title: Sharp endpoint growth and two extremizing masks for finite dyadic Haar-level projections
